_: The key each picture under public/ has in the bucket and on the CDN. The first rule whose `from` (a pattern on the path under public/) fits gives the key (`to`, where $1 is the pattern's first group and $& all it matched); a path no rule fits keeps its own path as its key. The app reads this to address a picture (src/lib/media.ts) and scripts/media/fill_public.mjs reads it to put public/ pictures in media/phi-media, so both always agree.
